scope: Compute six contact coefficients from native Rust simulation parameters
tolerance_reason: Small scoped f32 expression tolerances. Nexus MAX_FLT sentinel output, zero-timestep coefficients, input bytes and guard words are exact.
preconditions: Finite native parameter fields; nonnegative timestep/frequencies; positive damping and length unit; finite derived coefficients
invariants: Nexus MAX_FLT and TWO_PI are exported from Rust as bits, never confused with IEEE maximum or rounded decimal literals
Exactly the Nexus MAX_FLT sentinel suppresses length-unit scaling; adjacent-bit finite values are scaled normally
Zero timestep produces zero inverse timestep and zero CFM factors; zero frequency produces zero spring coefficients
Readonly parameters and output guards are bitwise preserved
outside_scope: Other simulation parameter helpers and joint coefficients
